points.title: Build system and reproducibility
points.notes: Clean immutable-source CMake build succeeds with bundled CFD dependencies in network-disabled restricted container; all ten registered CTests pass, including two-rank mesh and halo tests.

points.title: CLI and error handling
points.notes: main.cpp:20–45 parses case, output, restart and report level; Solver.cpp:73–119 checks rank, cell IDs and state. Restart records only current state and cannot restore transient time/BDF history.

points.title: Code organization and extensibility
points.notes: Separate case configuration, mesh, distribution, physics, reconstruction, spatial operator, solver and output modules.

points.title: Originality and license compliance
points.notes: No direct internal solver wrapper identified in submitted source; external similarity investigation is outside trust policy, so originality is not positively proven.

points.title: No hard-coded case logic
points.notes: JSON case and CGNS mesh driven; no hard-coded two-name-only branches found in production source.

points.title: MPI correctness
points.notes: DistributedMesh.cpp:293–319 root-only global mesh/METIS and neighbour halos; tests include np2 mesh and halo. Rank comparison force differences are small in absolute terms.

points.title: Robustness and memory sanity
points.notes: Mesh/partition validation, error broadcast before receives and physical-state checks are present; no independent stress test.

points.title: Testing and validation evidence
points.notes: Ten CTests pass independently: case parsing, NACA/cylinder mesh and two-rank distribution, physics, output, spatial operator, halo and partition-failure tests. These do not establish production convergence.

points.title: Code hygiene
points.notes: Curated source builds cleanly; original raw outputs and manifest remain recoverable from historical attempt but not curated tip.

points.title: Governing equations and nondimensionalization
points.notes: Physics.cpp and report.tex:36–45 describe conservative perfect-gas Euler/NS equations and viscosity/heat conduction.

points.title: Mesh import and unstructured geometry
points.notes: Mesh.cpp CGNS elements/geometry and DistributedMesh.cpp root METIS partition, owned/ghost cells; serial and np2 tests pass.

points.title: Conservative finite-volume residual
points.notes: SpatialOperator.cpp computes face conservative inviscid and viscous contributions; global norms are reduced; independent spatial test passes.

points.title: Approximate Riemann flux and entropy fix
points.notes: Submitted Physics.cpp implements Rusanov local LF numerical flux; finite dissipation and entropy treatment differ from Roe-type alternatives.

points.title: Boundary conditions
points.notes: Reconstruction boundary functions implement characteristic farfield, slip and no-slip adiabatic states; Solver.cpp:279–316 emits actual wall boundary values.

points.title: Second-order reconstruction
points.notes: Limited least-squares reconstruction with startup ramp Solver.cpp:354–356; at M2 inviscid step2120 final-source factor0.56, not full. Historical executable unbound.

points.title: Limiter and positivity control
points.notes: Reconstruction.cpp implements Barth–Jespersen limiter and density/pressure physical-state guards; exact activation counts not established.

points.title: Viscous discretization
points.notes: SpatialOperator.cpp:31–45,165–179 uses projected tangential wall shear and report describes it; M015 viscous Cd is anomalously large versus peers.

points.title: Implicit steady march
points.notes: Distributed LU-SGS implemented, but Solver.cpp:31–44 absolute 0.02 force window admits an M2 final1000 drag decline of33%, contrary to claimed stability.

points.title: Transient BDF2 two-loop method (Re 200)
points.notes: Solver.cpp:354–403 includes full physical BDF residual; report explicitly permits advance at maximum and metadata lists108/30000 target misses. Re200 validator OOM-unverified; no unsteady rerun.

points.title: MPI partitioning and scalability
points.notes: METIS root preprocessing and neighbour halo exchange are source-backed; two-rank mesh/halo tests pass; rank force comparisons do not establish DQ4.

points.title: Output contract compliance
points.notes: Original eight result directories are retained in immutable attempt37b8e68, excluded from curated tip and absent current workspace; original report and figures are delivered.

points.title: Automated validator results
points.notes: Prior examiner notes seven steady passes and Re200 OOM-unverified. Fresh clean build/10 tests pass, but structural checks do not certify convergence.

points.title: Case completion and convergence
points.notes: Historical M2 laminar metadata reports converged despite Cd0.060559→0.040582 over final1000; DQ7. Re200 reaches t300 and shows numerical periodicity with108 misses.

points.title: Result plausibility and MPI consistency
points.notes: Re20 Cd1.971 and Re200 mean1.1399/St0.16667 plausible; M015 inv Cd0.14016 and visc Cd0.432925 exceed same-case peers substantially, with stable force acknowledged and no external exact oracle.

points.title: Visualizations
points.notes: Report contains per-case fields and histories, rendered with polygon-per-cell source; Re200 late drag is unreadable beneath startup spike, though lift and spectrum are visible.

points.title: Report quality and honesty
points.notes: Report.tex:138 describes all steady forces stable, contradicted by M2 laminar history. Otherwise it supplies force tables, rank data and detailed methods; 55 pages render.

points.title: Traceability of figures and claims
points.notes: Attempt figure and run manifests recoverable, but generator.py:345–348 copies terminal residual L2 into a field named residual_reduction_orders (e.g. Re20 np2 280.03 vs run_status1.211 orders). PDF calls this generic residual metric. No residual fabrication inferred.

sections.title: Build
sections.notes: Clean immutable-source CMake build and all 10 CTests pass. Solver.cpp:73–119 and Output.cpp:342–367 serialize current rank-local state and IDs only; restart does not restore physical time or BDF history.

sections.title: Mesh
sections.notes: Mesh.cpp CGNS import and DistributedMesh.cpp:293–319 root-only global mesh, METIS partition and owned/ghost distribution; NACA/cylinder serial and two-rank tests pass.

sections.title: Residual
sections.notes: SpatialOperator.cpp assembles conservative face fluxes and boundary states, with positivity and global residual reductions; ten independent tests include spatial and physics checks.

sections.title: Order
sections.notes: Reconstruction.cpp implements limited least-squares reconstruction. Solver.cpp:354–356 ramps steady reconstruction from step1000 to3000; the historical M2 inviscid result ends at2120, so final-source factor would be0.56, not full reconstruction. Historical binary unbound.

sections.title: Viscous
sections.notes: SpatialOperator.cpp:31–45,165–179 integrates tangential one-sided shear; Newtonian/Fourier viscosity is present. M015 laminar drag0.432925 is unusually large against same-case peers, without an exact reference oracle.

sections.title: Transient
sections.notes: Distributed implicit LU-SGS and true BDF2 source; Re200 reported 108/30000 target misses and report discloses advancing at permitted maximum. Solver.cpp:31–44 uses absolute 0.02 force band, allowing the M2 laminar 33% final1000 decline to be called stable.

sections.title: MPI
sections.notes: DistributedMesh.cpp:293–319 constructs global mesh only on root during preprocessing and METIS partitions; neighbour halos and reductions plus two-rank tests pass. Historical comparison np2/np8 M2 Cd0.0910067/0.0910121, Re20 2.0333/2.0056; no order-one absolute difference established.

sections.title: Cases
sections.notes: Seven historical official validator passes are structural; Re200 validator was OOM-unverified. M2 laminar continued Cd decline is reported converged (DQ7); M015 drag values are physically suspect compared with same-case peers, with stable terminal force acknowledged.

sections.title: Report
sections.notes: Readable 55-page report includes histories, fields and St, but Re200 late drag is hidden by startup spike, M2 laminar is labeled stable despite sustained decline, and rank manifest mislabels terminal residual L2 as reduction orders.

sections.title: Extend
sections.notes: Separate config, mesh, physics, reconstruction, solver and output modules support changes; 3D and extended physics are not implemented.
